Familial cutaneous melanoma predisposition with atypical or numerous nevi. Uveal melanoma is an unquantified separate tumour risk, not common direct ocular involvement.

Defining amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia and congenital radioulnar fusion. Hearing impairment lacks evidence of frequency reaching 30%.

Broad digestive-system tumour category. Hepatobiliary tumours are a subgroup, not hepatic involvement shared by most patients.

Intellectual disability, microcephaly and developmental delay define the disorder. Delayed puberty and skeletal maturation alone do not establish endocrine or skeletal injury.
Autoimmune syndrome defined by tubulointerstitial nephritis and uveitis; both occur in 80-99%. Other organ findings are uncommon or nonspecific.
Somatic blood-cell glycosylation defect exposes Tn antigen, permitting antibody-mediated polyagglutination and cytopenias.
Nonspecific cutaneous disease localized to the leg; no additional organ or mechanism is established.
Acute inflammation of the lacrimal gland is usually viral or bacterial infection; noninfectious inflammatory forms also occur.
Isolated congenital absence of the gallbladder, which belongs to the hepatic axis.
Presynaptic neuromuscular junction disease; knee contractures in 4/7 and scoliosis in 3/7. Eye movement limitation is neuromuscular; respiratory weakness occurs in 2/7.
